about_the_game:
Goblin Quest: War is a new story in an old land.

Goblin Quest: War is an immersive fantasy sandbox with a nonlinear storyline.

Fully allowing you to play the story your way, with the player choice being our guiding gameplay mechanic.

Delve into Strongholds, fight against wildlife, or wage war throughout the region.

Explore the wastelands of Lynneaus,  lands filled with warring giants and the roaming dead.

The changing day cycles, weather systems and seasons changes affect the world around you and other in-game systems, such as the economy.

After finding yourself a Knight of the Crown, you must march into the wastelands and reclaim the region for the royal family.

This is where you start building your story.

Who will you save, enlist, or discover as you traverse the lands?

content_descriptors.notes: The content within the game contains depictions of non-consensual sex against women held captive.
